name: memtable_max_size
description: Maximum size of in-memory memtable before flush to disk
tuning: Increase for better write performance and reduced flush frequency. Decrease for lower memory usage and faster recovery times.

name: sstable_max_size
description: Maximum size of SSTable files on disk
tuning: Larger SSTables reduce file count and improve read performance for large datasets. Smaller SSTables speed up compaction and recovery.

name: max_levels
description: Maximum number of levels in the LSM tree
tuning: More levels allow for larger datasets with efficient storage. Fewer levels reduce read amplification but increase compaction frequency.

name: block_size
description: Size of data blocks within SSTable files
tuning: Larger blocks improve sequential read performance. Smaller blocks reduce read amplification for point queries.

name: l0_compaction_trigger
description: Number of Level 0 files before triggering compaction
tuning: Higher values allow more files before compaction, improving write throughput. Lower values reduce read amplification at the cost of more frequent compaction.
